release.notes_on_special_items: No earnings release for FY2019. Total Adjusted EBITA 312,673 / Adjusted EBITDA 353,663 thousand and NI recon from Form 10 'Summary Historical and Pro Forma Combined Financial Data'; segment GAAP OI / restructuring / acquisition-related amortization / other / Adjusted EBITA from Form 10 MD&A (USD millions printed); segment net sales and segment operating income from Form 10 Note 15 (thousands). Segment Adjusted EBITDA not disclosed for 2019. Pension settlement loss 33.6 is non-operating (MD&A lists it as an Americas item excluded from Adjusted EBITA). Adjusted Net Income defined in Form 10 but not reconciled/quantified for historical years.

notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).

FY2019 statements: audited combined statements in the Form 10 (third year presented). No EPS / share data for historical periods (carve-out): eps and shares null; dps null. Income statement has no discontinued-operations line (disc_ops=0).
IS: 'Pension settlement (gain) loss 33,616' (loss, expense-positive) and 'Interest (income) expense and other, net 997' (expense). Effective tax rate 20.2%.

CF: gain on sale of PP&E (667) in noncash_restructuring_impairment_gains; pension settlement loss 33,616 in other_noncash; repayments of short-term borrowings (4,888) debt_repayments; NCI distributions and 'Other financing (135)' in other_financing.

BS Dec 31, 2019: Form 10 presents balance sheets only for 2021 and 2020; only equity (NPI 3,058,666; AOCI (423,528); NCI 46,065; total 2,681,203) and cash 104,834 are populated; goodwill Jan 1, 2020 1,529,596 (Form 10 goodwill roll-forward) added.
Sales change FY2019 vs FY2018 not disclosed. Segment net sales change FY2019 not disclosed.

Adjusted EBITDA recon: Form 10 summary 'Interest expense (income) - net (1,083)' vs IS 997; other income 2,080 kept within Adjusted EBITDA (segment 'Other income (expense), net' (2.1) in MD&A). Recon ties exactly in thousands.

Segment: D&A incl. impairment Americas 39.722 / EMEA & APAC 40.350 (total 80.072); capex 13.995 / 30.459 (44.454); segment gross profit 343.1 / 453.3; SG&A 234.2 / 283.1; US-origin net sales 534.5. Mix: consumables 69% / equipment 31%.
Asbestos claims (Colfax FH/AGH, not in ESAB combined BS): unresolved end-2019 16,299; average cost of resolved claims $9,455. Balances for Dec 2019 not disclosed.

Dec 31, 2018 (Jan 1, 2019) from Form 10 statement of equity: NPI 3,050,926; AOCI (405,494); NCI 43,239; total equity 2,688,671; cash 70,969 (CF). Form 10 summary historical table covers only 2019-2021, so NO FY2016-FY2018 files written.

Other Dec 31, 2019 items (2022 10-K): allowance for credit losses 32.008; deferred tax valuation allowance 17.855; gross unrecognized tax benefits 34.014. ASC 326 cumulative effect at Jan 1, 2020: (3,734) total equity.
